summary: Batch-training cavalry civ. Golden Horde put an Ovoo on stone in Feudal, attack with Batu Khan, Torguuds and Keshiks, and dive during a Muscovy Yasak Castle timing.
openings: Sheep start, Feudal around 2:50, then 8 on wood, an Ovoo on stone around 4:25, a stable and 5 villagers on deer with a Fortified Outpost.
Usual path: Khan and Torguuds, then Muscovy Yasak, then Yam Network Trade.

spikes.label: Khan, Torguuds and Keshiks
spikes.detail: Batu Khan leads Torguuds and Keshiks out in batches in Feudal.
spikes.answer: Spearmen screens and towers near resources.

spikes.label: Muscovy Yasak timing
spikes.detail: They start the Muscovy Yasak age-up around 11:30 for ranged armor and automatic upgrades, then dive while you age up.
spikes.answer: Don't be mid age-up with no army when they arrive.

scout: A stable in Feudal producing Keshiks

pairings.why: Added against infantry, with men-at-arms in Castle.

winConditions.detail: Stone from the Ovoo funds stone-only technologies.

howToBeat: Their Ovoo is always exposed; spear-rush it.
Patches shift this civ a lot, so expect its strength to change.
